CI/test modernization (Oct 2020–Apr 2022): GitHub Actions replaced Travis CI (badge replacing Coveralls); Python 3.10 support added (#359, 0.19.1) and Python 3.11 testing (#368); tests use built-in `unittest.mock` instead of third-party `mock`; `test_ipython` is skipped if IPython is unavailable (#397); tests copy the existing environment to keep `PYTHONPATH`. Motivated by modernizing CI and easing distro packaging (Fedora, Gentoo).

Interactive mode detection was improved (#183, June 2019) by checking whether `__main__` has `__file__` defined instead of using `globals()`, whose check was always true. The library was also made compatible with pyinstaller.
Release history in 2018: 0.8.1, 0.8.2 (docs moved from rst to md, changelog added), 0.9.0, 0.9.1, 0.10.0 and 0.10.1, between March and December 2018, maintained by Saurabh Kumar.

UTF-8 BOM is stripped in Reader.__init__ so the first variable in BOM-prefixed .env files (common from JetBrains IDEs on Windows) is no longer silently lost (#640, fixes #637, April 2026). Empty dotenv dicts are now cached (#638).

CLI `get` and `list` commands give clearer error messages (e.g., 'Error opening env file: [Errno 21] Is a directory'), with I/O refactored to reduce syscalls and races (November 2022); the previous message was confusing.

`dotenv run` switched from `subprocess.Popen` to `os.execvpe` (#523, proposed by eekstunt, July 2024), replacing the dotenv process with the user's command so only one process remains and signals such as SIGTERM reach the command directly (e.g., in Docker). Behaviour is preserved since the old approach only propagated the child's exit code; it also avoids a hanging parent process consuming RAM. execvpe turned out to be problematic on Windows and was fixed later (#566, June 2025).

CI/test infrastructure changed: GitHub Actions replaced Travis CI (with a GitHub Actions badge replacing Coveralls); Python 3.10 support was added (#359, 0.19.1) and Python 3.11 testing (#368); tests use built-in `unittest.mock` instead of third-party `mock`; `test_ipython` skipped if IPython is unavailable (#397); tests copy the existing environment to keep `PYTHONPATH`. | When: 2020-10 to 2022-04 | Involving: Saurabh Kumar, Michał Górny, Ville Skyttä, Karolina Surma | Modernize CI and ease distro packaging (Fedora, Gentoo)

Variable expansion was refactored in November 2020 (v0.15.0): parsing and expansion were decoupled into two steps (parse value into atoms of literals/variables, then resolve to a string). This fixed inconsistent resolution with override=False, so `PORT` and `URL=http://localhost:${PORT}` now resolve consistently; `load_dotenv` behavior is unchanged (always override=True).

CLI changes (May 2019–Aug 2020): `set` gained `--export` to prepend `export` and creates `.env` in the current directory if none is found; `dotenv run` no longer crashes on variables without values; keys without values are supported; `set_key` escapes values before quoting (#236); `run_command` was moved into the cli module.

Python 2/3 compatibility conventions: keep support for older Python versions and avoid mandatory dependencies. Environment keys/values are encoded for os.environ in Python 2 using `sys.getfilesystemencoding()` with UTF-8 fallback (#177); `typing` is optional (#179, fixes #178) with a `collections.namedtuple` fallback for `Binding` and a test run without typing; a Python 3.5.0/3.5.1 import error was fixed; `io.open` is used for py2 compatibility. Earlier (Mar 2019), type hints were exposed to users with the `typing` dependency restricted to Python < 3.5, and an argument to choose the .env file encoding (default None) was added. In Oct 2018, Python 3.3 support was dropped (#150), flake8 W605 fixed (#149), and environment variables forced to str on Python 2 for Windows (#101) to avoid a subprocess TypeError.

Parser fix (June 2026): an unquoted empty value followed by an inline comment (`KEY= # comment`) is parsed as an empty string rather than the comment text, because the equal-sign regex had consumed the whitespace the comment-stripping rule needed. `KEY=#novalue` and `KEY=a#b` are unchanged (closes #600, #663).

Packaging was modernized (Oct 2025–Jan 2026): project metadata and config moved to pyproject.toml with the build backend declared and 'build' used (#583); follow-up fixes covered coverage config; publishing to PyPI switched to a trusted publisher; a license specifier fix (#597) used the correct table format after pip complained about the license property.

Documentation tooling moved (April–June 2022) from Portray to direct MkDocs use with mkdocstrings (public API only) and mdx_truly_sane_lists, because Portray had layout problems and documented too much. Docs are deployed via `mkdocs gh-deploy`, and a GitHub Actions workflow deploys them on release.

Default encoding for `load_dotenv` and `dotenv_values` changed to "utf-8" (from None, which used the locale), passed to `io.open`, so a project file like `.env` does not depend on the user's locale. Breaking only for non-UTF-8 locale users with non-UTF-8 .env files; Flask and Docker Compose already use utf-8. Later (2022-02-19) an `encoding` parameter was added to `{get,set,unset}_key`. This revises the earlier March 2019 default of None.

Interpolation work (Jan–Jul 2020): control over interpolation (v0.11.0), Bash-like default values in variable expansion (v0.13.0), fixed interpolation order, and fixed empty expansion for duplicate keys by passing all bindings in order rather than deduplicating into a dict (v0.14.0).

Test infrastructure (Nov 2018): the `dotenv` package was moved into a `src` directory so tests run against the installed version; tox was added to run tests across multiple Python versions with coverage plus flake8, and Travis CI was updated to use tox. `__file__` is special-cased in Python 2 (fixes #130).

Error-handling improvements (Sept–Oct 2026): rewrite() no longer leaves a .tmp_* file or masks the original write error when cleanup fails on Windows with a read-only .env (#686); set_key and unset_key write errors now name the .env path (#711, fixes #710).

BREAKING change (January 2026, #607): `dotenv run` forwards flags given after the command to that command instead of interpreting them, e.g. `dotenv run ls --help` shows the help of `ls`. Flags for `dotenv run` itself go right after `run` (e.g. `dotenv run --override ls`), and generic options go right after `dotenv` (e.g. `dotenv --file path/to/env run ls`).

The CLI `list` command has a `--format=` option (simple, shell, export, json) added in July 2022; `simple` remains the default for backwards compatibility. It enables importing variables into shell scripts via eval "$(dotenv list --format=shell)".

`load_dotenv` and `dotenv_values` accept any text stream (`IO[str]`) as `stream`, such as `open("foo", "r")`. Shipped in release 0.19.0 (July 2021).

Runtime issues are reported through the `logging` module rather than `warnings` (change of Nov 2019): warnings expose python-dotenv source lines to users and are meant for programming issues, and were noisy in tests. Testing on Python 2 needs the `mock` package. The CLI may later use print/click.echo.

Test suite isolation (#160, Jan 2019): tests use `dotenv_file` and `tmp_path` fixtures (preferred over `tmpdir`, which relies on py.path in maintenance mode) with unique directories, so failing tests don't leave files behind and tests can run in parallel. Previously failing tests left files that broke others, manual cleanup was easy to forget (#153), and shared files prevented parallel runs.

Release 1.2.4 (October 1, 2026, from 1.2.3) shipped with fixes: `dotenv get` exits 0 for empty string values (#700, fixes #699), --no-override is honored when expanding variables in `dotenv run` (#698, fixes #697), and inline comments on empty unquoted values are handled (#663).

Typing was tightened in July 2021: Mypy 0.900+ was enabled (needs `types-mock`), checking of untyped defs was turned on, and `set_key`/`unset_key` `dotenv_path` argument types were fixed to match `dotenv_values`. A June 2021 CI fix addressed Mypy requiring type packages even with `ignore_missing_imports`.

Regression fix in 0.10.1 (#158, Dec 2018): in the new regex parser `\s` matched newlines so the equal-sign matcher consumed them, making `FOO=\nBAR=b` parse as `[("FOO","BAR=b")]` instead of FOO empty and BAR=b (fixes #157). Python 3.7 was added to the test suite in the same release.

Subsequent parser fixes (Nov 2019–Sept 2020): malformed lines print a warning on stderr while parsing continues; comment-only lines no longer trigger a warning, via an `error` field added to `Binding` (the earlier Binding structure could not tell comment-only lines from malformed ones); unquoted values with multiple adjacent spaces/tabs parse correctly (2020-09-09); the warning on an empty last line was removed.

Tilde expansion: a leading ~ is expanded to the user's home directory in load_dotenv, dotenv_values, get_key, set_key, unset_key and the CLI --file option (#615, fixes #525), then extended to find_dotenv and the IPython %dotenv magic (#714), so users can pass ~-prefixed paths (Sept–Oct 2026).

items.text: python-dotenv dropped Python 2 support in June-July 2021 ('Require Python >= 3.5', fbc7a63) to simplify code, add features and lower the barrier to contribution. Cleanup followed: removed Python 2-specific code (`to_env`/`to_text`), 'coding: utf-8' declarations, unnecessary future imports and typing guards, replaced `Text` with `str`, and adopted Python 3 type hints. This supersedes the earlier Python 2/3 compatibility conventions.

Parser overhaul in python-dotenv 0.10.0 (#148, Dec 2018): parsing is no longer line-based (`parse_line` replaced by `parse_binding`), parsing code was deduplicated, and `get_stream` became a context manager. Added support for multiline values, backslashes in values, trailing comments and unquoted UTF-8 values. The regex was inspired by Ruby bkeepers/dotenv and supersedes PR #142. Goal: make parsing easier to change and test (fixes #89, #112, #141, #147). It was later replaced by a handwritten top-down parser (#180, May 2019).

The parser was refactored (#180, May 2019) from a single large regex into a handwritten top-down parser with smaller regexes in a separate module, because one regex could not satisfy the parsing requirements. This fixed inconsistencies after 0.10.0: escapes were interpreted in single-quoted strings, and `#` started a comment even without preceding whitespace. Escape interpretation in double-quoted strings was kept.
Parser recovery was improved to handle CRLF invalid lines, with a test verifying line numbers after CRLF parser recovery (#669, October 2026).

Behaviour is preserved since it only propagated the child's exit code. | Involving: @eekstunt | Avoids a hanging parent process consuming RAM and improves signal handling for containerized/production use

Platform checks use `sys.platform == "win32"` everywhere. | Involving: Bertrand Bonnefoy-Claudet, Saurabh Kumar (co-author) | Protect Windows-specific code from regressions while improving `dotenv run` error handling
